product_name: Adobe Firefly · image generation and editing

scope.experience: Text-to-image generation followed by image-specific refinements
scope.task: Generate a fictional product illustration, choose a variation, and refine its composition or background before downloading.
scope.configuration: User-triggered image generation and editing with visible prompt, style and composition controls. No particular image model or paid plan was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: An individual creating visual assets with a web editor

conversational.rationale: Natural-language prompts sit inside a structured generate/select/edit workflow with image controls rather than a general ongoing conversation.
conversational.uncertainty: Other Firefly experiences may be more conversational; the assessed feature is text-to-image and editing.

specialization.rationale: Image composition and generation are specialized creative tasks supported by aspect ratio, style, lighting and reference controls.
specialization.uncertainty: The broader platform supports other media; this profile is not an average of all Firefly tools or models.

autonomy.rationale: The system creates image candidates or local edits from a description, while users direct iterations and choose the finished artifact.
autonomy.uncertainty: No autonomous publishing or project-wide creative decisions are assumed.

accessibility.rationale: A web workflow and natural-language generation lower the technical barrier to producing images compared with building them manually.
accessibility.uncertainty: Visual assessment, account access, generation credits and regional availability impose limitations; no assistive-technology test was performed.

explainability.rationale: Prompt and settings are visible, but generation does not give users a complete evidential explanation for the pixels, objects or artistic choices produced.
explainability.uncertainty: Content provenance or editability does not itself explain model decisions; this profile does not assess licensing or output accuracy.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: Adobe Firefly image generation and human-directed edits, excluding other media and automated pipelines. Scores are design estimates. Source: https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/text-to-image.html .
